description:
Keep issue details responsive on first selection and when selections or refreshes overlap.

## Background

The load effect starts a request before a later issue-change effect resets its sequence counter. The resulting response no longer matches the counter, leaving the first selection loading. Resetting a reused counter can also let an older request match a later selection.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Selecting an issue displays its returned details or error and clears loading, including the first selection.
- [hard] REQ-02: Out-of-order responses from earlier selections, clearing the selection, or older refreshes cannot replace the current selection; fresh version updates still refresh it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Automated component tests exercise first selection, overlapping selections and version refreshes, and clearing and reselecting an issue.
title: Load issue details safely across selection changes
